name: ReadUnsignedLeb128
evidence: reads an unsigned number of 7-bit groups (the top bit marks a continuation) from the unwind tables and returns the position after it

name: ReadSignedLeb128
evidence: reads a signed number of 7-bit groups, extending the sign from bit 6 of the last byte, and returns the position after it

name: MergeFrameLists
evidence: merges the second sorted array of frame descriptions into the first, from the back, ordered by key (unwind.c)

name: FinishFrameTableSort
evidence: ends the sort of a frame table: splits off the out-of-order descriptions, heap-sorts them, merges them back and frees the spare list; aborts when the counts disagree (unwind.c)

name: CountFrameDescriptions
evidence: counts the frame descriptions of a block that have a common record and a start address (unwind.c)

name: CollectFrameDescriptions
evidence: appends a block's usable frame descriptions to a list and widens the lowest and highest code address it has seen (unwind.c)

name: BuildFrameTableIndex
evidence: counts and collects a registered block's frame descriptions, sorts them and stores the sorted table with the code range it covers (unwind.c)

name: FindFrameDescription
evidence: finds the frame description holding a code address: picks the registered block covering it (building its index on first use), then binary-searches its sorted table (unwind.c)

name: ParseCommonFrameRecord
evidence: reads a frame description's common record: its augmentation string, handler data, code and data alignment and return column, and returns where its instructions start; 0 for an unknown augmentation (unwind.c)

name: RunUnwindInstruction
evidence: runs one unwind instruction (advance the location, record a register saved at an offset, set the frame address rule, push or pop the rule state) on an unwind state and returns the next instruction (unwind.c)

name: RegisterFrameInfo
evidence: original assembly: adds an object's frame information to the runtime's list D_0062A7B8 (RegisterProgramFrameInfo calls it at startup)

name: DeregisterFrameInfo
evidence: removes an object's frame information from the runtime's list D_0062A7B8, freeing its sorted table, and aborts when it is not there (ReleaseProgramFrameInfo calls it at exit)

name: FindFrameUnwindState
evidence: finds the frame description of a code address and runs its unwind instructions into a state record (the throw and rethrow entries call it)

name: SplitOutOfOrderFrames
evidence: moves the frame descriptions that break the key order out of an array into a second one and closes the gaps (unwind.c)
